guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 查看 BaiBai 应用
guide.description: 原文要求进入 BaiBai 应用，点击连接钱包（Connect Wallet），并将钱包网络切换为 Base。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to the BaiBai app and click “Connect Wallet.” Switch your wallet to the Base network if it isn’t there already.

guide.title: 核对 Base 上的 USDC 或 ETH 资金要求
guide.description: 原文称交易需要 Base 上的 USDC 或 ETH；跨链或提款可能产生费用。交易所推广和跨链组件广告已省略，请勿据此直接转入资金。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Fund Your Wallet With USDC or ETH on Base
guide.original_description: You need USDC or ETH on Base to trade. You can buy either asset on Bybit and withdraw directly to Base. Holding funds on another chain? Move them over with the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 了解首次兑换流程
guide.description: 原文流程：选择卖出和买入代币、输入金额、核对报价，点击交易（Trade）；若提示代币授权，核对额度和合约后再签名。原文声称无需 Gas，该手续费条件尚需核验。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Pick the token you want to sell and the one you want to buy, enter an amount, and review the quote. Click “Trade,” approve the token if prompted, and sign. No gas is needed.

guide.title: 了解交易积分规则
guide.description: 原文称积分与交易量、活跃度有关，建议分散交易日期和币对，并查看是否有活动倍数。增加交易会产生资金风险，不应为了未经确认的空投刷交易量。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Points are based on trading volume and activity. Spread trades across different days and token pairs instead of placing one large swap, and check the app for any active multipliers before you trade.

guide.title: 核对代币化股票的积分加成
guide.description: 仅在所在地区允许且平台提供代币化股票时查看该功能。原文称这类交易曾有临时 2 倍积分加成，需先核对活动是否仍有效。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Trade Tokenized Stocks for Boosted Points
guide.original_description: If tokenized stocks are available in your jurisdiction, swap into them on BaiBai. These trades have earned a temporary 2x points boost, so confirm the multiplier is still running first.

guide.title: 查看并分享 Rekt 记录
guide.description: 原文称进入 BaiBai Rekt 页面，生成并分享记录（receipt）可获得额外积分。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Visit the BaiBai Rekt page , generate your receipt, and share it to collect bonus points.

guide.title: 使用你的邀请链接邀请朋友
guide.description: 打开积分（Points）页复制邀请链接。原文称你获得被邀请用户积分的 10%，被邀请用户获得 10% 积分加成；请核对有效规则。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Invite Friends With Your Referral Link
guide.original_description: Open the Points page and copy your referral link. You earn 10% of the points your referrals generate, and they receive a 10% points boost.
